title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
summary: Gridded modelled (reanalysis) historical weather served per coordinate by the Open-Meteo archive endpoint. Using the daily variable temperature_2m_max (°C) it can supply a daily maximum temperature series for any latitude/longitude and timezone. Probes confirmed responses for 2025-06-01 to 2025-06-03 and 2026-03-29 to 2026-03-31 at a northern-Italy test point (45.46, 9.19, Milan area, used only as a probe; the shop's real location is not stated in the use-case spec). The full UC2 windows (2023-06-01 to 2026-03-31) were not probed beyond these end points.

fields.name: daily.time
fields.description: Day of observation, in the requested timezone

fields.name: daily.temperature_2m_max
fields.description: Daily maximum air temperature at 2 m

schema.notes: Response also carries hourly arrays (temperature_2m, shortwave_radiation) when requested; the register default_query includes hourly, so the probe needs hourly overridden to empty to get daily-only output. Probe grid point returned was 45.448154, 9.169279, elevation 138 m.

spatial.notes: Any point can be queried; the Italian shop location is not specified in the use-case spec, so the coordinate must be chosen and justified in decisions.md. Register default (38.72, -9.14) is Lisbon and must be overridden. Probe used 45.46, 9.19 (Milan area), returned grid point 45.448154, 9.169279.

ownership.publisher: Open-Meteo.com (API operator; underlying reanalysis from Copernicus Climate Change Service C3S per licence page)

access.request_process: GET https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive with latitude, longitude, start_date, end_date, daily=temperature_2m_max, timezone=Europe/Rome; hourly must be overridden to empty. Register approved purposes: prototyping, production (policy.open_data_links requires Legal sign-off for production use).

Keep probe ranges to a few days (api.open_meteo_archive param_notes)
quality_notes: Register default_query is Lisbon (38.72, -9.14) with timezone UTC and hourly variables; both must be overridden for an Italian daily maximum. Setting timezone=Europe/Rome gives local-day maxima.
Reanalysis (modelled grid values), not station-observed. Peaks may be smoothed relative to a local station; the shop's nearest weather station is not identified in any source read.
Probe result: daily temperature_2m_max returned for 2025-06-01..03 (30.7, 27.3, 24.5 °C) and 2026-03-29..31 (18.2, 19.2, 15.5 °C); no nulls in these 6 values.
Full history window 2023-06-01..2025-05-31 not probed; only the ends of the recent window were checked.
Test point Milan (45.46, 9.19) was a probe choice, not a justified shop location.
